subject: Discovery recap - BrightCart embeddings + rerank (index scale, latency, next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@brightcart.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap - BrightCart embeddings + rerank (index scale, latency, next steps)

Hi Alex - great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap from our call and suggested next steps so we're aligned.

Pain points you shared:
- Product search relevance degrades for long-tail SKUs and seasonal catalogs; current rerank model struggles with long queries.
- Embedding index maintenance is slow (reindex jobs block during peak hours).
- Cost and latency spikes during Black Friday / promotional windows - engineering wants predictable unit economics.

Current stack you mentioned:
- Vector DB: Pinecone (up to 200M vectors today, sharded across 8 indexes)
- Embedding model: on-prem microservice producing 1536-d vectors (batch jobs)
- Rerank: in-house transformer fine-tuned for pairwise rerank, deployed in k8s pods
- Serving pattern: mix of real-time (p95 latency target) and batched nightly re-ranks

Success criteria you listed:
- 95th percentile latency <= 50ms for top-K retrieval + light rerank path for interactive queries
- Support 50-100 qps sustained during peak windows, with burst to 500 qps for short periods
- Cost target: keep per-1M-query incremental cost under your current budget (~$300-600/1M calls, if possible)
- Index size scalability to 200M vectors with seamless rolling updates and minimal downtime

Technical notes we discussed (what Redwood can help with):
- Prefix/KV cache to accelerate repeated queries for popular SKUs and avoid repeated embedding recompute
- Intelligent batching for embedding ingestion to reduce GPU utilization and lower unit cost for bulk updates
- Model routing: serve lighter quantized variants for low-latency interactive queries, full model for high-quality batch rerank
- Vector DB integrations: we can work with Pinecone (we've validated at similar scale) or Parkway/Weaviate/FAISS depending on preference

Proposed next steps:
1) Pilot scope doc: small pilot that targets a single catalog (20M vectors), live A/B for queries on product search. Attached SOW template to start.
2) Tech validation call with your infra/ML engineer (Jamie) + our SE (Rafael) - propose Wed 11/05 or Thu 11/06, 40 minutes.
3) We'll provide an expected cost profile for the pilot (per-token/per-query estimates) and a quick latency model based on your traffic patterns.
4) If pilot looks good, expand to full index and evaluate autoscaling/burst policies for seasonal peaks.

Please confirm: the 200M number was peak projected - is 20M a safe starting slice for the pilot? Also, can you share sample qps/peak windows for last Black Friday spike?

Attachments: redwood-embed-pilot-sow.pdf, redwood-architecture-diagram.png

Thanks - happy to tweak the plan.

Best,

Subject: Re: Discovery recap - BrightCart embeddings + rerank (index scale, latency, next steps)

Thanks Marissa - this is a great recap and captures our priorities. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Pilot index: 20M vectors sounds perfect as a canary.
- Current production: ~180-200M vectors across the catalog. Peak qps during Black Friday last year was ~420 qps sustained for ~3 hours, with spikes up to ~900 qps for short bursts.
- Latency: our frontend team wants p95 <= 50ms for retrieval + rerank only for the top 10 candidates (we can relax for batch re-ranks).
- Vector DB: we use Pinecone today but are open to alternatives if the economics/latency justify it.

We'll loop in Jamie (cc'd) - she'll share telemetry for the last holiday spike (qps timeline, percentiles) and a sample subset of the catalog for pilot ingest.

I'm available for the tech validation call Thu 11/06 10:00-10:40am PT. Rafael - can you make that?

Alex
Senior Product Manager, BrightCart
alex@brightcart.com

Alex / Jamie - thanks for the updates and for sharing telemetry ahead of the call. Quick follow-up on our side so the tech validation session is productive:

1) Can you share a small sample manifest: 1k vectors + 50 representative queries for local replay? That will let us run retrieval + rerank latency numbers end-to-end.
2) For the pilot, do you prefer: a) we manage a Redwood-hosted pilot with Pinecone integration, or b) we deploy Redwood Private in your VPC (we can provide an OVA/container bundle) for full network locality? We can scope costs both ways.
3) Success metrics we'll instrument during pilot: p95 latency for retrieve+rerank, total cost per 1M interactive queries, and percent delta in NDCG@10 vs your current rerank model.

Marissa - I'll put together a lightweight MAP (mutual action plan) and SOW draft after the tech call. Alex / Jamie - see you Thu 11/06 10:00am PT.
